title: Gauge Unification & Supersymmetry — Developed Model-Selection Programme
status: project unification archaeology + developed GUT/SUSY comparison framework
abstract: This branch asks whether the recovered higher-dimensional and supersymmetric unification programme can be converted into a concrete four-dimensional gauge theory with calculable representations, symmetry breaking, renormalization-group evolution and observables. The central scientific move is to stop treating Pati-Salam, SU(5), Spin(10), supersymmetry and 11D geometry as cumulative vocabulary and instead treat them as competing or nested model routes. A viable route must reproduce the observed chiral Standard Model content, define the Higgs representations and breaking scales, cancel anomalies, predict threshold-corrected coupling evolution and produce at least one quantitative observable such as proton decay, neutrino masses, new vector bosons or a superpartner spectrum. This redevelopment adds explicit representation decompositions, one-loop matching logic, a measurable unification residual, proton-decay scaling, seesaw structure and a minimal SUSY benchmark contract. The result is a theory-selection framework: explanatory compression is rewarded when a larger group genuinely reduces independent charge assignments or relates sectors, but extra symmetry earns no value if it only creates unmeasured parameters. The branch is T2 as a developed GUT/SUSY research programme; no unique Timic GUT or supersymmetry-breaking model has been selected.
research_question: Which single gauge-unification route gives the best combination of representation compression, coupling consistency and surviving quantitative predictions, and can any 11D or supersymmetric completion derive that route rather than merely contain related group names?
recovered_project_context: Tim explicitly requested M-theory/string/supersymmetry and cross-domain unification work in May 2026.
The specific SU(5), Pati-Salam and Spin(10) machinery is archive/research development unless primary project evidence is recovered.

standard_model_contract.group: SU(3)_C x SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y up to global quotient convention
standard_model_contract.success_condition: every candidate route must reproduce these low-energy representations and acceptable Yukawa/Higgs structure

pati_salam.compression: quarks and leptons share SU(4)_C multiplets and left/right structure is explicit
pati_salam.distinctive_work: derive breaking SU(4)_C->SU(3)_C x U(1)_(B-L), right-handed scale, neutrino mass mechanism and heavy vector spectrum

su5.adjoint_breaking: 24_H can realize SU(5)->SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) in the minimal textbook route
su5.compression: one generation is organized into two irreducible SU(5) representations
su5.tension: simple realizations face proton-decay, fermion-mass and doublet-triplet-splitting challenges

spin10.compression: a complete generation including a right-handed neutrino fits in one irreducible representation
spin10.cost: realistic breaking and Yukawa sectors require explicit Higgs representations and often intermediate scales

procedure: List every chiral multiplet under G_GUT.
Decompose it under each subgroup in the breaking chain.
Verify the final multiplicities and hypercharges match the observed Standard Model.
Check all gauge and mixed anomalies for the actual chiral spectrum.
Track convention changes between right-handed fields and left-chiral conjugates.
representation_test.failure: a visually appealing group embedding is not a model if the actual chiral spectrum is wrong

symmetry_breaking.meaning: a breaking arrow becomes physics only when the order parameter and resulting spectrum are calculable

renormalization_group.piecewise_thresholds: change b_i whenever the effective particle content changes and impose matching at thresholds
renormalization_group.meaning: unification should be quantified as a residual with uncertainties, not judged by whether three plotted lines look close

proton_decay.dimension6_scaling: Gamma_p roughly scales as alpha_U^2 m_p^5/M_X^4 times matrix-element and RG factors
proton_decay.lifetime_scaling: tau_p proportional to M_X^4/(alpha_U^2 m_p^5) up to model-specific factors
proton_decay.scientific_use: proton non-decay places direct pressure on simple low-scale GUT mediator masses; a serious model must calculate dominant channels rather than cite a group name

neutrino_extension.meaning: if Spin(10)/Pati-Salam motivates nu_R, the theory should convert that representational success into a neutrino-mass calculation
neutrino_extension.test: fit masses/mixings and check whether the required heavy scale is compatible with the chosen breaking chain and other observables

supersymmetry.meaning: supersymmetry pairs bosonic and fermionic degrees of freedom before breaking; the algebra alone predicts no collider spectrum
supersymmetry.generic_soft_scale: m_soft is not fixed by the symmetry; it must emerge from the breaking mediation mechanism
observable_interfaces: dark matter only if a stable state is actually specified

minimal_susy_unification_benchmark.purpose: give the branch one reproducible calculation without asserting a preferred real-world model
steps: Take measured alpha_1,alpha_2,alpha_3 at a reference scale.
Run with Standard-Model beta coefficients up to a trial SUSY threshold M_S.
Above M_S use the declared supersymmetric spectrum's beta coefficients.
Propagate threshold uncertainty rather than treating one crossing point as exact.
Use the resulting M_U and mediator content to estimate proton-decay pressure.
minimal_susy_unification_benchmark.value: this turns 'SUSY improves unification' from a slogan into a model-dependent quantitative statement

11d_bridge.question: Can a compactification produce the chosen 4D gauge group, chiral matter and couplings?
11d_bridge.boundary: finding the same group in an 11D/string construction is not enough; the low-energy spectrum and interactions must follow

model_selection_rule.principle: prefer the smallest route that actually explains more; larger groups are not automatically deeper theories
model_selection_rule.anti_bloat: do not add E6/E8 or additional dimensions until the current route has a defined deficit that the extension specifically repairs

failure_conditions: Incorrect low-energy chiral spectrum or hypercharges.
Uncancelled anomalies in the proposed matter content.
No viable breaking vacuum or unacceptable light remnants.
Couplings miss unification beyond declared threshold/higher-loop uncertainty when unification is claimed.
Predicted proton decay or new particles conflict with current limits in the claimed region.
SUSY branch has no viable breaking/spectrum or adds no explanatory/predictive value.
11D embedding does not derive the actual 4D spectrum/couplings.
next_decisive_calculations: Choose one explicit route, preferably Spin(10) or SU(5), rather than keeping all routes active equally.
Write one complete representation and breaking ledger with Higgs fields.
Perform a threshold-aware coupling-running benchmark and compute Delta_GUT.
Derive one proton-decay or neutrino-mass observable from the same parameter set.
Only after that ask whether an 11D compactification can generate that model.
